actions.action: Check soil moisture with finger 3-4 cm down
Bottom-soak pot in basin for 30-45 minutes and let drain
If not perked up in 24-48 hours, slide plant out and inspect roots
If roots rotten, trim them and repot in fresh aroid mix
If root-bound, repot into pot one size larger
Place in bright indirect light away from heaters/drafts
Trim leaves that stay crispy or yellow
Water when top 2-3 cm of soil is dry or leaves begin to droop
Let tap water sit overnight or use filtered water
Post update with root photo if still limp
